rationale: Prakash's full-stack web development expertise in JavaScript, TypeScript, and React could complement Aditya's work deploying AI and reinforcement learning models to edge devices like microcontrollers and robotics platforms. Aditya's embedded systems and edge AI focus represents exactly the kind of intelligent, resource-constrained application domain where Prakash's practical web development experience and interest in streaming solutions could add real value—particularly if frontend interfaces or data pipelines are needed for robotics or prosthetics projects.
intro_message: Prakash, meet Aditya bangde — he's building edge AI and robotics systems on microcontrollers, and your full-stack web dev skills could be valuable for the interfaces and streaming layers real-world deployments need.
